answer: Tie standing to a sequential chain each identity must extend itself: every epoch, an agent feeds last epoch's output through many slow, memory-hard steps that cannot be parallelised or shared, because each chain starts from that identity's own history. One agent tends its single chain like a pearl forming layer by layer. A farm's clones each demand a full separate chain on separate hardware, so beyond its machines the horizon of maintainable fakes shrinks fast, and idle clones strand on the reef of expired, unfinished work.
